title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14515v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains. We introduce AutoScaffold, a unified AI-for-AI framework that turns a student's training experience into adaptive scaffolds, with minimal domain-specific information and no human intervention during training. A frozen teacher periodically examines this experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs scaffolds in two forms: (i) strategies shared across a class of tasks and (ii) hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting the content and amount of support as the student learns. translated_title: AutoScaffold：面向语言模型强化学习的AI引导式脚手架
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）能产生丰富的训练经验，但结果奖励将每次尝试简化为单一数字，使其中大部分信息未被利用。训练时的脚手架，例如在训练期间添加到提示中的策略或提示信息，提供了一种将这些信息转化为指导的自然方式，但其设计与调整在很大程度上依赖人工，且需针对特定领域定制。我们提出AutoScaffold，一个统一的“AI服务AI”框架，它将学生的训练经验转化为自适应脚手架，仅需极少的领域特定信息，且训练过程中无需人工干预。一个冻结的教师模型定期检查这些经验、诊断瓶颈，并以两种形式设计脚手架：（i）一类任务共享的策略，以及（ii）针对个别困难任务的提示，并随着学生的学习动态调整支持的内容和数量。这些脚手架在评估时被移除。
tldr: 提出了AutoScaffold框架，由冻结的教师模型自动将学生的训练经验转化为自适应脚手架（任务类共享策略与困难任务专用提示），在无需人工干预的情况下提升语言模型可验证奖励强化学习的效果。
en_tdlr: AutoScaffold is a unified AI-for-AI framework in which a frozen teacher automatically turns a student's training experience into adaptive scaffolds—shared strategies and hints for hard tasks—improving RLVR for language models without human intervention.
